name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.iamessaging.InAppMessageCustomActivity
description: When Dataroid AppConnect triggers a full-screen custom in-app campaign, this screen displays its localized content in a web page and records that the message was viewed.
disableEffect: If AppConnect tries to show a full-screen custom campaign after this screen is disabled, its direct launch may crash the app and the message cannot appear.
